gloss: faintly, slightly, just a hint of

definitions.explanation: To a very slight degree; having just a trace of something. Often describes subtle colors, scents, or sensations.

examples.japanese: {頬|ほお}がほんのり{赤|あか}くなった。
ほんのり{甘|あま}い{香|かお}りがする。
{空|そら}がほんのり{明|あか}るくなってきた。
examples.english: The sky began to grow faintly bright.

examples.japanese: ほんのり{暖|あたた}かい{風|かぜ}が{吹|ふ}いた。

notes:
USAGE: ほんのり describes subtle, gentle degrees of sensory experiences - colors, scents, temperatures, or tastes. It has a soft, delicate nuance.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・ほんのり{赤|あか}い (faintly red)
・ほんのり{甘|あま}い (slightly sweet)
・ほんのり{暖|あたた}かい (slightly warm)
・ほんのり{明|あか}るい (faintly bright)
・ほんのり{香|かお}る (to have a faint fragrance)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・うっすら: Faintly, dimly (often visual)
・かすかに: Faintly, barely (more general)
・ほんのり: Slightly, just a hint (pleasant, soft quality)

NUANCE: ほんのり often conveys a pleasant, aesthetically pleasing quality of subtlety.
